sources.entry: FlowVision - RWaterfall-style Image Viewer for macOS. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon] ![Freeware][Freeware Icon]](https://github.com/netdcy/FlowVision)

summary.one_liner: FlowVision is a waterfall-style image and video viewer for macOS with Finder-like file management and right-click navigation gestures.
summary.what_it_does: A macOS image viewer that displays images in an adaptive waterfall layout and supports both light and dark mode. It offers Finder-like file management, and right-click gestures to jump to the previous or next folder containing images or videos. The README lists performance optimizations for directories with many images, high-quality scaling to reduce moiré, video playback, HDR display support, and a recursive mode. Mouse and keyboard controls cover zoom, pan, 100% and fit-to-view, and folder navigation (W/A/S/D keys mirror the gestures).
use_cases: browse large folders of photos on a Mac
view images and videos in a waterfall layout
quickly move between image folders with gestures
navigate a disk folder tree while viewing pictures
notable: Right-click gestures for moving between folders with images or videos, and up to the parent directory
Waterfall-style adaptive layout with light and dark mode
Recursive mode and HDR display support
States it makes no internet connection and is open source
caveats: Build from source requires Xcode 15.2+ and manually arranged dependencies, including a prebuilt ffmpeg-kit binary; the README says the project is discontinued and the prebuilt binaries were removed, with a backup offered
Library list in the build section is blank in the README
